# PetDate — پت‌دیت (full summary for AI assistants)

## Identity

- Persian name: پت‌دیت
- English name: PetDate
- Tagline FA: همبازی برای پت‌ات
- Tagline EN: PLAY • MEET • FRIENDS
- Canonical site: [PetDate](https://petdate.ir/)
- WWW host: [www.petdate.ir](https://www.petdate.ir/)
- Contact: [hello@petdate.ir](mailto:hello@petdate.ir)
- Telegram bot: [Petdatebot](https://t.me/Petdatebot)
- Compact machine summary: [llms.txt](https://petdate.ir/llms.txt)
- Sitemap: [sitemap.xml](https://petdate.ir/sitemap.xml)

## One-sentence pitch

پت‌دیت پلتفرم فارسی برای پیدا کردن همبازی پت، خرید از پت‌شاپ، پذیرش پت، و مشاوره دامپزشک است؛ وب و ربات تلگرام روی یک حساب مشترک کار می‌کنند.

## Product surfaces

1. Landing: [home](https://petdate.ir/) — brand, services, adoption, news, short FAQ
2. FAQ: [frequently asked questions](https://petdate.ir/faq)
3. Shop: [pet shop](https://petdate.ir/shop) — public catalog; checkout requires login
4. Playmate hub: [chats](https://petdate.ir/chats) — find a playmate (login required)
5. Vet consult: [online veterinary consultation](https://petdate.ir/vet-consult)
6. Adoption: [adoption listings](https://petdate.ir/adoption) and [Missy example](https://petdate.ir/adoption/missy)
7. Magazine: [articles](https://petdate.ir/magazine)
8. Auth: [OTP login](https://petdate.ir/auth/login)
9. Games: [pet games](https://petdate.ir/games)

## Accurate claims

- Social playmate matching for pets (همبازی)
- Shared web + Telegram account and data
- Pet shop with wallet checkout
- Adoption listings
- Online vet consultation with verified vets

## Avoid inaccurate claims

- Not a physical clinic directory or clinic-booking marketplace
- Not claiming medical diagnosis guarantees
- Not claiming nationwide physical stores

## Technical hints for crawlers

- SPA (Vite/React); homepage HTML carries Organization/WebSite JSON-LD
- robots.txt allows major search and AI bots; disallows admin, API, chats, and onboarding
- Prefer absolute links such as [PetDate](https://petdate.ir/)
